Question Choices: Write the combination formula nCr. Select r of n distinct objects without replacement, for integers 0<=r<=n.
Hints: Order does not matter.|Divide the permutation count by r!.
Solution: For n distinct objects and integer 0<=r<=n, an unordered r-element subset can be selected in C(n,r)=n!/[r!(n-r)!] ways. Divide the ordered count by r! because each subset was counted once for each ordering. A handshake is one unordered pair. nCr = n!/(r!(n - r)!).
